question: If x is subtracted from each of 52, 47, 20 and 19, the numbers so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 4) and (x - 8)?
solution:
Given:

If x is subtracted from each of 52, 47, 20 and 19, the numbers would be in proportion. 

Concepts used:

Componendo and Dividendo

If p:q :: r:s, then 

Componendo

⇒ (p + q)/q = (r + s)/s

Dividendo

⇒ (p - q)/p = (r - s)/s

Mean Proportional between two numbers a and b = √ab
